**Symmetric `to` 40-hex validation in advanceCursor (issue-259 D2 PR1)**

**What**: Added `if (typeof to !== 'string' || !HEX40.test(to)) throw new Error('advanceCursor: to must be a 40-hex sha')` in advanceCursor, placed after the `from` validation and BEFORE the merge-base ancestor check. Return `{ from, to }` now echoes the HEX40-validated `to` (a pinned OID, never symbolic).
**Why**: Round-2 judges confirmed a hole: `to` was passed RAW while `from` was HEX40-validated. `advanceCursor({from:C0,to:'main'})` advanced the cursor to main's LIVE moving tip, skipping past unreviewed commits (main's tip is a descendant of C0 so the ancestor check passed). Human assert path (design §2.4) must be a pinned OID.
**Where**: brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/cursor.mjs (advanceCursor); brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/cursor.test.mjs (added 2 tests: symbolic/garbage `to` throws + remote unchanged; positive path returns 40-hex OID). Also removed dead `fetch`/`rev-parse` stub branches from the B6 fakeGit (readCursor only calls ls-remote now).
**Learned**: Kept the merge-base ancestor check intact — it is a SOUND forward-only ordering guard, and running it BEFORE the push makes a well-formed non-commit 40-hex (tree/blob OID) fail closed at merge-base. Mutation bar verified: removing the HEX40.test(to) guard turns the new test RED (to:'main' advances instead of throwing); positive path stays green. 24 pass in cursor.test.mjs, 5 in git-seam.test.mjs. Do NOT run npm test in repo root (rewrites git identity) — use file-scoped node --test.
